_note: The screen phase's own vocabulary (Phase 05). Absence of evidence is NEVER grounds to filter: every list here is used to find a POSITIVE signal for a junk category, never to find the absence of a quoting request. Product, media and fitting vocabulary belongs to the engine (vendor/config/rules.json) and is deliberately NOT duplicated here (CONVENTIONS: never re-express an engine rule in kit code) — the quoting-request veto asks the vendored classifier itself.
_categories_note: ORDERED — list order is behaviour, first match wins, exactly like rules.json's own precedence lists. code is SCREAMING_SNAKE like open_items[].code. route is deliberately DISJOINT from open_items[].route (inside_sales, order_desk, account_owner, catalog_lookup) and routing.recommendation (inside_sales_review, order_desk, account_owner), so a consumer can never mistake a filtered message for a routed-but-undrafted case. detector names the tier/check in filter_gate.py that decides this category.
_quote_request_cues_note: request_act half of the quoting-request veto: is this a request AT ALL, independent of product words (the engine assumes yes, so this is genuinely new vocabulary, not a second copy of a rule). Phrases only — no product/media/fitting nouns.
_invoice_phrases_note: Positive invoice/statement evidence in subject or body (content tier — no protocol header marks this category).
_ack_phrases_note: Used under a dominance test in filter_gate.py: after stripping quoted history and signature, the remainder must be UNDER ack_max_chars AND match one of these — never bare substring presence against the raw body.
_auto_reply_localparts_note: Sender local-parts consistent with an out-of-office / vacation responder, corroborating the RFC 3834 Auto-Submitted header check.
_dsn_sender_localparts_note: Bounce/DSN sender local-parts, corroborating the multipart/report + message/delivery-status structural check.
_bulk_precedence_values_note: Precedence header values that corroborate List-Unsubscribe for the bulk-mailing tier. List-Unsubscribe alone is never sufficient (a real customer can run a mailer too) — it must be paired with one of these or with List-Id.
_thresholds_note: ack_max_chars bounds the dominance test for BARE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT (short polite remainder only). html_scan_bytes bounds the HTML-only fallback body the gate will run mail.html_to_text on before failing open — chosen to stay well under the engine's superlinear cost at the ~1 MB scale the gate must handle in under a couple of seconds (FOLLOW-UP-9).
_round_29_note: ROUND 29 removed three categories and two signals outright. Round 29 dropped 11 of 46 genuine RFQs: 6 to accounts_payable via an invoice_phrases SUBSTRING ('net 30' in a purchasing email is evidence of a purchase order, not an invoice), and 5 to no_action via auto_reply_localparts ('no-reply@', 'donotreply@' -- the standard sender of every sourcing portal and ERP requisition notice, i.e. the most common way a B2B RFQ arrives). INVOICE_OR_STATEMENT, BARE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT and INTERNAL_CHATTER judged a message by its prose or its addressing; no phrase list makes that safe, so they are gone. What remains is only what a sender's software DECLARES about the message under RFC 3834/3464: an automatic reply, a delivery report, or list mail. Invoices, bare acknowledgements and internal notes now reach the engine and produce a draft to dismiss -- noise, not loss.
